World Cup Preview MD1 & My Predictions - 5/6/2026

📅 June 5, 2026 ✍️ Konstantinos Chaldoupis

The 2026 World Cup is just around the corner, and the excitement is palpable! With 48 teams set to compete across North America, this tournament promises to be one of the most thrilling in history. As we gear up for the kickoff, let's take a look at some of the key matchups and my predictions for how things will unfold.

Key Matchups to Watch in Matchday 1

A rematch of the 2010 opening match happens again as Mexico faces South Africa this time around in Mexico City Stadium hoping to get the full 3 points this time.

One more exciting matchup to look forward to is the clash between Brazil and Morocco in Group C as two of the best teams in each confederation play each other that might decide first place and runner up of this group.

Another exciting matchup is the clash between the Netherlands and Japan in Group F with both teams having met once before in the 2010 World Cup where Netherlands clinched on the 3 points thanks to a goal from Wesley Sneijder and an assist from Robin van Persie.

A battle of former colonies is on as France takes on Senegal. The meeting carries deep historical weight, with many of France's own players having family ties to Senegal. On the pitch, it's a clash of generations — European efficiency versus African flair — both fighting for pride and progression.

These are just a few of the many exciting matchups to look forward to in the 2026 World Cup. With so much talent on display and the stakes higher than ever, it's anyone's guess who will come out on top. I can't wait to see how it all unfolds!
